title: Ice, Pillows, and Orders  (Hielo, almohadas y órdenes)

segments.t: Diez minutos más tarde, en el rincón del café de la Posada del Patio del Tilo, Owen baja dos almohadas firmes para apoyar el tobillo de Tessa mientras Hannah le entrega una carpeta con pinza y un lápiz. Escucha primero toda la escena.
Two firm pillows under your heel, Tessa, and strict orders not to touch the floor.
Fine, fine. If I cannot stand at the stove, listen carefully to my kitchen rules!
Clipboard ready, Chef Tessa! Who gets the six o'clock bread dough?
Owen has strong shoulders: he kneads the morning dough while I watch the timer.
Deal! I used to help my grandmother knead Sunday loaves every week.
And who whisks the lemon curd and chops carrots for the lentil soup?
You whisk the lemons at my elbow, Hannah, and Caleb chops every vegetable to the millimeter!
Believe me, Caleb will measure every carrot cube with a ruler!
What job do we give Arthur so he feels helpful without breaking anything?
Polishing the twelve white cups at the table, far away from switches and paint!
Now drink this chamomile tea and go rest upstairs, Tessa.
Wake me at six sharp: nobody touches my oven without me in that chair!
Repasemos cada instrucción de esta brigada de cocina improvisada.
Two firm pillows under your heel, Tessa, and strict orders not to touch the floor.
'Dos almohadas firmes bajo tu talón, Tessa, y órdenes estrictas de no tocar el suelo.'
Fine, fine. If I cannot stand at the stove, listen carefully to my kitchen rules!
'Está bien, está bien. Si no puedo estar de pie frente a los fogones, ¡escuchen con atención mis reglas de cocina!'
Clipboard ready, Chef Tessa! Who gets the six o'clock bread dough?
'¡Carpeta lista, chef Tessa! ¿A quién le toca la masa de pan de las seis de la mañana?'
Owen has strong shoulders: he kneads the morning dough while I watch the timer.
'Owen tiene hombros fuertes: él amasa el pan de la mañana mientras yo vigilo el temporizador.'
Deal! I used to help my grandmother knead Sunday loaves every week.
'¡Trato hecho! Yo solía ayudar a mi abuela a amasar las hogazas de los domingos todas las semanas.'
And who whisks the lemon curd and chops carrots for the lentil soup?
'¿Y quién bate la crema de limón y pica las zanahorias para la sopa de lentejas?'
You whisk the lemons at my elbow, Hannah, and Caleb chops every vegetable to the millimeter!
'¡Tú bates los limones justo a mi lado, Hannah, y Caleb pica cada verdura al milímetro!'
Believe me, Caleb will measure every carrot cube with a ruler!
'¡Créanme, Caleb medirá cada dadito de zanahoria con una regla!'
What job do we give Arthur so he feels helpful without breaking anything?
'¿Qué tarea le damos a Arthur para que se sienta útil sin romper nada?'
Polishing the twelve white cups at the table, far away from switches and paint!
'¡Sacar brillo a las doce tazas blancas en la mesa, bien lejos de los interruptores y de la pintura!'
Now drink this chamomile tea and go rest upstairs, Tessa.
'Ahora bebe esta infusión de manzanilla y ve a descansar arriba, Tessa.'
Wake me at six sharp: nobody touches my oven without me in that chair!
'Despiértenme a las seis en punto: ¡nadie toca mi horno sin que yo esté en esa silla!'
Escuchemos por segunda vez toda la escena.
Two firm pillows under your heel, Tessa, and strict orders not to touch the floor.
Fine, fine. If I cannot stand at the stove, listen carefully to my kitchen rules!
Clipboard ready, Chef Tessa! Who gets the six o'clock bread dough?
Owen has strong shoulders: he kneads the morning dough while I watch the timer.
Deal! I used to help my grandmother knead Sunday loaves every week.
And who whisks the lemon curd and chops carrots for the lentil soup?
You whisk the lemons at my elbow, Hannah, and Caleb chops every vegetable to the millimeter!
Believe me, Caleb will measure every carrot cube with a ruler!
What job do we give Arthur so he feels helpful without breaking anything?
Polishing the twelve white cups at the table, far away from switches and paint!
Now drink this chamomile tea and go rest upstairs, Tessa.
Wake me at six sharp: nobody touches my oven without me in that chair!

Con el pie bien alto sobre las almohadas, la chef Tessa ya ha repartido cada puesto del miércoles por la mañana hasta el último dadito de zanahoria. Pasemos ahora a la octava y última escena del episodio.
Good night!
